scenario_description:
Objective: Recover the already-paid replacement MetroRide card from the library kiosk so its transferred value can be used Monday.
Emerging Need: The transfer succeeds, but the card is physically retained behind a jammed dispenser shutter.
Decision Context: The stored old-card serial and paid replacement receipt allow staff to identify the retained card. Prepare a no-charge release request and collection plan; do not retry the transfer, purchase another card or pry the kiosk.
Consequence: After the visiting attendant seals the kiosk for the holiday, the replacement cannot be collected before Monday travel.

parameter.title: MetroRide card replacement transfer
parameter.content: Collect a replacement for the lost green MetroRide card and move its existing stored value; no new pass or auto-reload.

parameter.description: Replacement MetroRide card purchase at the library kiosk; receipt notes a stored-value transfer flow offered after activation.

parameter.subject: Stored value transferred; replacement card dispensing
parameter.body: The existing value has transferred successfully to the replacement purchased under receipt replacement-card-2026-04-19. The kiosk is dispensing that paid card; do not start a second transfer.

parameter.content: The kiosk finished the transfer but the plastic replacement card never came out. Its screen says the dispenser shutter is jammed and the card is safely retained inside. I am still at the library and can return this afternoon; I am not going to pry the slot.

parameter.subject: Library kiosk attendant collection window
parameter.body: The visiting attendant can release retained replacements at no charge today 13:00-14:00. Send the old registered card serial and replacement purchase reference to the stored MetroRide intake before 13:00 so the attendant can identify the card; Mina must collect it in person by 14:00. No new card fee or fare purchase is needed. The library kiosk will then be sealed until Tuesday.

parameter.subject: Library kiosk sealed until Tuesday
parameter.body: The visiting attendant has left and the kiosk is sealed until Tuesday morning. The uncollected paid replacement remains safely inside; its value is not lost, but it cannot be collected for Monday's journey through today's window.
